**all seven rungs are one statistical tier** on the GS maps (the
487-tile instrument cannot resolve differences below ~0.03 F1)

values.quantity: count of cost/performance rungs on the GS pass-budget board
count of statistical tiers spanned by the seven rungs
tile count of the gold-standard instrument
smallest F1 difference the 487-tile instrument can resolve

claims.notes: Analysis `pass-budget-pareto-v2`. `$.rungs` has seven entries and `$.tiers` is a single tie-list (manifest outcome: '0/21 pairs significant after BH-FDR'). The ~0.03 resolution floor is a derived statement about the permutation null (the pairwise entries carry `null_std` ≈ 0.013 at n_tiles = 487) and needs scripted recomputation, not a read.
